method.elapsed: End-to-end local wall time; DO elapsed includes waiting. These are NOT CPU timings.
method.memory: CDP heap snapshots plus QuickJS live guest allocation and WASM linear-memory snapshots. NOT production isolate peak. RSS is whole workerd process.
method.network: All external HTTP handled by local fixtures; no real provider traffic. Geo fixture adds a synthetic 5ms wait.
